decision_cruda.rationale: LH-02 is down (radio and CMMS agree), and the likely repair is 13:20. LH-10 is idle at the workshop, so lending it costs no production or development. Travel is 0.49 h, so it arrives about 09:50. TJ-E569-07 has 168 t at 10.5 g/t, which is about 56.7 oz. LH410 loads 27.5 t/h, so it clears the stope in about 6.1 h, before 17:00 allowing for lunch. Este has 72 t/h of truck capacity against 0 inflow, so it is not truck-limited. No reserve activation is allowed because no stope has stopped. No loaders were taken from other places.
